shifts.summary: Most candidates reported the paper as moderate overall. Reasoning was generally easy but some found it tough due to time pressure. General Awareness was mainly static with a few current affairs and heavily based on previous year questions. Quantitative aptitude was the most challenging section with many lengthy calculations, while English was considered easy and largely PYQ based.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Most questions were doable but time pressure caused skips. Many statement‑type and coding‑decoding items appeared. Logic was easy for most, with few dice questions.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: GA was mainly static with a few current affairs items. Questions were heavily based on previous year papers. Topics covered history, business, and key constitutional facts.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Quant contained many advanced calculations and lengthy items. Time management was a major issue, with several candidates skipping questions that took more than 30 seconds. Topics ranged from geometry to profit‑loss and compound interest.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: English was easy and largely based on previous year questions. Candidates performed well on passage comprehension and grammar, though some found active‑passive items challenging.

observations: Time management was a recurring issue, especially in the Quant section.
General Awareness relied heavily on previous year questions.
English was the easiest section for most candidates.
Reasoning questions were mostly easy but some candidates faced difficulty with statement‑type items.
disagreements: Reasoning difficulty was reported as Easy, Easy to Moderate, and Tough across sources; Quant difficulty ranged from Easy to Difficult.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Two long Time‑Work questions ate time, arithmetic calculations were lengthy, and while some advanced parts were easy once formulas were known, overall timing was critical.

sections.notes: Grammar and comprehension were easy, though many words made full attempts harder; candidates made 5‑6 guesses and took a bit more time on the passage.
